Display of wholesale/maximum retail
price on goods
*321. SHRI KAILASH JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court has
asked Government to evolve a policy for
display of wholesale price alongwith
maximum retail price printed on goods; and
(b) if so, what action Government have
taken in the matter?
Permission sought by CBI to file
court cases
†*322. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of cases are pending under consideration of
Government for which Central Bureau of
Investigation had asked for permission to
file court cases;
(b) if so, the number of such cases till
September, 2002; and
(c) the number of cases in which
Government have granted its approval
during the years 1999, 2000, 2001 and till
September, 2002?
Food Insecurity Atlas of Urban
India
*323. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Nagpur has been ranked at the lowest level
i.e. 18th while Pune is on 1st position on
the food security index in the Food
Insecurity Atlas of Urban India compiled
by Swaminathan Research Foundation in
collaboration with the World Food
Programme; and
(b) if so, what steps Government

(an essential input) is maintained at
comparatively even levels atleast in
metropolitan cities to begin with, with
provision to gradually eliminate insecurity
in food level all over the country?
Indian  fishermen  captured
by Pakistan Marine
Security Agency
*324. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Indian fishermen and
boats captured by the Pakistan Marine
Security Agency and since when they have
been captured; and
(b) the action taken by his Ministry to
get the fishermen released?
Revenue sharing between BSNL and
VSNL
*325. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether an agreement has been
reached between BSNL and VSNL over
the revenue sharing formula in International
Long Distance (ILD) services; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Telephone facility in Chhochhi village
in Haryana
*326. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no telephone
facility is available in Chhochhi village of
Beri Block in District Jhajjar, Haryana;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps Government propose to take
to provide telephone facility in that village
till January, 2003?
National Highway 83
†*327. SHRI LALU PRASAD:
SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Jahanabad to
Dobhi section of National Highway No. 83
in Bihar is not in good condition;
(b) whether it is a fact that a proposal
pertaining to the said section has been
submitted to his Ministry by the State
Government; and
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to take any action in this regard and if so, by
when?
Annual growth rate
†*328. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether an assessment of the annual
growth rate in the agricultural, industrial and
service sectors in the country has been made
by Government in order to achieve the target
of 8 per cent annual growth rate during the
Tenth Five Year Plan period;
(b) if so, the annual growth rate
necessary for these sectors; and
(c) the average annual growth rate in
these sectors during the Ninth Five Year
Plan period?

(a) whether Government are aware that
Taliban forces are reorganising in the border
areas of Pakistan in preparation for a new
wave of terrorist attacks on Afghanistan as
per recent news reports;

484
Production of Khadi in Andhra
Pradesh
2204. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the production of Khadi in Andhra
Pradesh during the last three years,
year-wise;
(b) how it compares with other Khadi
producing States; and
(c) what steps KVIC has taken to ensure
quality control and marketing development
of Khadi in the State?
Setting up ARIs in rural/tribal areas
2205. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning to
set up Agro and Rural Industries to process
the food in the Rural and Tribal regions;
(b) if so, the details for the next five
years, State-wise, area-wise and product-
wise; and
(c) the amount Government have already
spent to encourage Agro and Rural
Industries in the remote hinterland of the
country in order to save the food (vegetables
and fruits) getting rotten?
Beneficiaries of PMRY
†2206. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the beneficiaries of
PMRY, so far, State-wise, district-wise and
category-wise since its inception;
(b) whether Government have included
this scheme in the Tenth Five Year Plan; and
(c) if so, the details of the target fixed in
this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

485
WIN2\SESSION\6208RS-QUES 485
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Radioactive monitoring stations
2207. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of radioactive monitoring
stations to check radioactive levels set up in
the country;
(b) whether air samples are collected
regularly and analysed to check
environmental pollution from radioactive
substances; and
(c) the agencies monitoring the radiation
levels?
Power generation from Thorium
2208. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has abundant quantity
of Thorium for nuclear power generation;
and
(b) if so, the action proposed for more
nuclear power generation to meet power
crisis?
Technology and fuel for nuclear power
generation
†2209. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
countries have refused to supply atomic
technology and atomic fuel in lieu o f
atomic energy and India has to rely upon
the old fuel; and
(b) if so, the names of such countries
alongwith the reasons for their refusal?
Nuclear radiation threat
2210. SHRI SANTOSH
 BAGRODIA:
DR. KARAN SINGH:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any Central unit has been
constituted that would act in time of nuclear
radiation threat in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether its role has clearly been
studied and defined at the time of crisis such
as nuclear radiation threat?
Exemption of BARC reactors from
AERB's inspection
2211. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that reactors of the
Bombay Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
are exempted from the purview of AERB;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
and
(c) who can check the BARC reactors?
Allotment of STD/ISD/PCO to
physically handicapped in Tamil Nadu
2212. SHRI P.G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of applications pending
with Government for allotment of STD/ISD/
PCO's under physically handicapped
category at different places/towns in
Tamil Nadu and since when such
applications are pending;
(b) what are the norms for opening of
STD/ISD/PCO's under this category; and

486
WIN2\SESSION\6208RS-QUES 486
(c) the details of STD/ISD/PCO's
cleared and allotted in the State during the
last three years, district-wise?
Special software programme for the
handicapped
2213. SHRI P.G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any special software
programme has been developed for deaf,
dumb and visually disabled persons in the
country;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
(c) the centres where such programmes
are being run for the disabled persons; and
(d) the additional centres proposed to be
opened during the next three years in
different parts of the country to give equal
participation to disabled people in all areas
of life?
